_README: THE PROFILE — layer ③ of four. Answers: HOW does it render?
Copy to profiles/<you>-resume.json. That copy is gitignored; this is the shape.
The live public Hub profile is profiles/examples.json — keep that file so clones
still see Jane Example after you add your own card.
ONE profile per person. There are NO per-track profile files — a profile per role
track duplicates the vault and drifts out of sync with it. The per-role framing
(what to lead with, what to demote) belongs in the VAULT at roleTracks.<track>.angle.
So this file holds only what is TRUE REGARDLESS OF TRACK: layout, export paths,
name: Your Name — Personal Resume (base profile)

privacy.reason: Real personal resume data. profiles/<you>-resume.json is gitignored.

voice: Pointer only — do not design voice here. THE ONE person-level voice-design area is users/<you>.json#characterVoice; application prose is vaults/<you>.json#voice. Optional network map: <VOICE_SEED>/registry.json.

leadIdentity.rule: OPTIONAL. If lead identity CHANGES by track, put the map in the vault ONLY — profile keeps a pointer.
leadIdentity._note: Do not duplicate per-track lines here; they drift. Keep track-specific framing in the private applicant profile.

roleTracks._note: Defined in the VAULT, not here. Pointer only — do not copy the available[] list.

theme.default: Your brand palette — see users/yourname.json -> brandTheme.
theme.modeNote: Derive the palette from the TARGET COMPANY's real brand CSS when they give a usable signal; store it at _job-apps/<Track>/theme.json (it belongs to the company, not to you). Fall back to your brandTheme otherwise.
theme.pairing: If two people apply to the SAME company: both render from the company palette with SPLIT accent runs — same grid and type, different accent order — so they read as a matched pair from one studio rather than two copies of one document.
theme.houseRule: themes/PALETTE-RULES.md — no brown, no mustard, no lime. Enforced on every export.

layout.note: Resume = exactly 2 pages · cover letter = 1 · merged bundle = 3.

coverLetterPolicy.rule: No separate cover-letter profile — this profile owns its letters. The RESUME stays company-agnostic within a track (so it is reusable across jobs in that track). The COVER LETTER carries ALL company-specific content: the mission hook, their named projects mapped to the listing, the recipient block, and any honest gap framing.
coverLetterPolicy.mergeCommand: python -m pdf_tool.merge_pdfs <out>.pdf <cover-letter-light>.pdf <resume-light>.pdf --require-letter --title "Your Name - <Role> - Cover Letter and Resume"

exports.rule: PDFs and PNGs go to resumes/<user>/_exports/<Application-Dir>/ — NEVER into the application folder. The application folder holds the listing doc, application.json, theme.json, and the .html sources only. This keeps everything ONE person needs to send in one place.
exports.deliverable: Unless asked otherwise, an application ships: resume light+dark PDF, cover letter light+dark PDF, and the merged FINAL bundle. PNGs only on request.
